profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ FoundryZero | Building 0→1 Software Products | React Native, Node.js, Supabase
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer and founder based in Austin, focused on turning early ideas into thoughtfully designed, production-ready software.

I’m a Senior Software Engineer at FoundryZero, a venture studio that originates, prototypes, and operates software products. My work spans product strategy, mobile and web development, backend architecture, data systems, cloud infrastructure, applied AI, deployment, and the operational work that follows launch.

I created the FoundryZero website from the ground up and currently lead engineering for Mosaic, a health companion that brings nutrition, workouts, wearables, progress, and personalized coaching into one connected experience. Mosaic is now available on iOS and Android.

Previously, I spent three years at iCode Austin, progressing from computer science instructor into campus and technology leadership. I also co-founded Lafellus, an AI plagiarism-detection startup supported through ASU Venture Devils. I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Arizona State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead end-to-end software development for FoundryZero, a venture studio that originates, prototypes, and operates software products. My work spans product architecture, mobile and web applications, backend services, applied AI, infrastructure, and production operations.

Key Contributions:

Architect and develop Mosaic, a cross-platform health application available on iOS and Android
Build and maintain the React Native and Expo mobile client, supporting nutrition, workouts, habits, progress, and wearable data

Design backend APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows using Node.js, Express, Supabase, and PostgreSQL

Develop AI-powered features that provide personalized coaching and interpret health and nutrition context
Integrate Apple Health, Android Health Connect, WHOOP, subscriptions, authentication, analytics, and attribution services

Manage deployment, observability, security, QA, and release workflows across Railway, Supabase, the App Store, and Google Play

Create internal administration and operational tools for product support, evaluation, and data management

Designed and developed the FoundryZero website and venture pages from the ground up, including its responsive design system, content architecture, and production deployment

Collaborate across product, design, and operations to turn early-stage concepts into reliable, user-facing software

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
I support IT operations, data management, and STEM instruction for a fast-paced technology education center, helping ensure smooth experiences for students, families, and staff.

Key Contributions:

Maintain and document internal systems, tools, and integrations

Provide technical support for software, hardware, and classroom technology

Support data reporting and analytics to guide operational decisions

Perform QA testing on platforms and data flows to ensure reliability

Teach iCode Belt Program courses in coding, game dev, and engineering

Represent iCode at community events and assist with curriculum improvements

positions.title: Campus Director
positions.description:
As Director, I led enrollment growth, community partnerships, and instructional excellence for a STEM education center serving K–12 students. I managed marketing, operations, and team leadership to expand our impact and deliver high-quality learning experiences.

Key Contributions:

Drove enrollment growth through marketing funnels (email, social, community outreach), resulting in a 30% increase in net new students in the first academic year

Expanded school partnerships and secured MOUs with three campuses, bringing after-school STEM programs to 100+ students

Supervised and developed a cross-functional team of instructors and operational staff to ensure exceptional educational outcomes and parent satisfaction

Collaborated across marketing, curriculum, and operations to improve enrollment processes, lead nurturing, and student experience

Represented iCode at community and district events to strengthen brand awareness and build long-term relationships with families and schools
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Assistant Campus Director
positions.description:
Led and closed instructional trial classes tailored to each student’s interests and skill level, driving enrollments and supporting revenue goals

Managed daily office operations, instructor scheduling, and parent communications to ensure seamless center performance

Collaborated with the Director and instructional team to improve program placement, student experience, and retention outcomes

Served as a primary point of contact for families, providing guidance on curriculum pathways, scheduling, and center policies

Supported marketing and community outreach efforts to increase visibility and demand for STEM programs
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Co-Founder | Developer
positions.description:
Co-founded Lafellus, an early-stage venture focused on developing an AI-powered plagiarism detection platform for academic and professional content integrity. Contributed to product vision, technical development, and early traction efforts.

Key Contributions:

Helped define product requirements and model approach for an AI plagiarism detection engine aimed at improving originality verification for students, educators, and content creators

Secured early-stage funding through ASU Venture Devils, supporting initial research, prototyping, and brand development

Designed and developed the Lafellus marketing website to articulate value proposition, capture early interest, and support investor conversations

Conducted competitive research on plagiarism and content-scoring tools to inform product positioning and feature roadmap

Collaborated with cofounders on go-to-market strategy, pitch materials, and customer discovery interviews within academic communities
positions.insights: JSON Web Token (JWT), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +8 skills

projects.title: Albumatic - Social Media Platform
projects.description: Developed a full-stack social media platform designed to enhance user interaction through a robust relational database and dynamic content features. Functionality includes secure user registration, profile management, photo sharing, album creation, commenting, tagging, and a personalized "For You" recommendation feed powered by engagement and interest signals.

projects.title: Budget Tracker
projects.description:
Built and deployed a full-stack budgeting application that helps users manage their finances using the 50/30/20 rule. The platform features secure JWT-based authentication, real-time income and expense tracking, customizable budget settings, and interactive spending visualizations. Developed a Flask REST API with PostgreSQL for persistent data management and a responsive React frontend powered by Chart.js for dynamic dashboards. Fully deployed on Render using Gunicorn, serving both the API and production React build.

Tech Stack: Flask, React, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, PyJWT, Chart.js, Render, Gunicorn, Node.js, Express, JavaScript, Python

organizations.name: Theta Chi Fraternity
organizations.position: Vice President of Health and Safety · Jan 2022 - Dec 2022
organizations.description:
Serve as an executive board member responsible for leading chapter health and safety initiatives. In this role, I champion risk management programming, promote member well-being, and ensure alignment with university and national organizational standards.

Key Focus Areas:

Develop and deliver health, safety, and risk-prevention programming to chapter members and the wider campus community

Support crisis response, policy education, and adherence to organizational and university guidelines

Collaborate with chapter leadership to foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, and proactive member support

This position has strengthened my leadership, communication, and organizational governance skills within a values-driven environment.
